data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding per the balance sheet prior-year column (31 Dec 2014) is shown at GBP 172.629m. The closing gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2015 is materially lower (GBP 106.260m), indicating a net reduction in gross claims outstanding over the year. No explicit gross prioryear movement (movement in prior years) figure was found in the available pages; therefore no quantified prioryear development is reported here.
data.data_quality_notes: Data extracted from scanned images of the 2015 Syndicate 1110 annual report. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position prior-year column (31 Dec 2014) at GBP 172,629k (172.629m) - page ~21. The report images provided did not contain a clearly labelled gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure or a clearly legible gross claims development (triangle) table accessible for automated extraction; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is reported as null. A simple comparison of opening (172.629m) and closing (106.260m) gross claims outstanding implies a total reduction of about 66.369m during 2015, but this total change includes current-year movements and therefore was NOT used as the prior-year development figure per the extraction rules. Gross written premium (211,510k) was visible but the segmental breakdown (exact class names and amounts) could not be reliably parsed from the scanned pages; gross_premium_mix left empty. Many note tables and narrative lines were difficult to read in the provided images; extractive confidence is therefore limited. If higher fidelity (searchable) PDF or original pages are provided, the movement-in-prior-years note, precise prior-year development (gross), and the premium segmental analysis can be extracted with higher confidence.
